items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: That’s the kind of stuff you know where you have Dave and Iola for parents you end up thinking about.

ctx.x: at what age did it occur to you that my father and my mother are engaged in a business that most people are not.

Well I can say for me, one of my specific early memories is that, as you probably know Dave really messed up his back, broke his back, broke his neck in this diving accident in the late 40s in Hawaii. And so his back was always, you know, just a time bomb waiting to screw up and so he would say like, “I have a concert” and it would be not too far away. And he would just say, “Does anyone want to come with me?” And I remember I liked it and I said, “Yeah I’ll come with you.” And he said, “But yeah, on the way back…

Yeah and for me I remember, you know, specific times. Like I went on the road with my dad when he went to Mexico. That was kind of a famous tour. And actually Monk was on that tour and I guess it was a George Wein festival that went all over the place. And just, you know, being in these huge auditoriums and seeing people really going nuts, like literally picking up a row of chairs and smashing them down and you’re going whoa. I mean people were really going crazy like it was a soccer game or something. That was…
